status: upstream input-to-state producer gap confirmed in the active N177 path

evidence.adapter_ingest_input: taiji/adapter.py:11094 converts input bytes to Observation and PerceptEvent records and returns InputTrace; it does not derive WorldObject, WorldEvent, or Goal facts from natural Chinese
evidence.task_interpretation: taiji/adapter.py:8269 accepts goal_description and constraints from its caller
evidence.semantic_provider_path: taiji/adapter.py:8302 validates caller/provider-supplied SemanticEvidenceProposal; it is not a Taiji-learned raw-text parser
evidence.joint_input_bridge: JointTaskState.append_input receives both the InputTrace and an already-created CognitiveState
evidence.t1_t2_t3_fixture_boundary: current N177 tests construct structured owner facts and T3 goal targets; they verify downstream identity/consumption, not natural-Chinese extraction

architecture_verdict: Current N177 proves that structured, source-bound content can reach memory/world/selection/language consumers. It does not prove raw Chinese input creates that structured content inside Taiji. Starting a joint capability training package on injected structured facts would skip the input producer and could overstate semantic ability.

required_next_slice.producer: opt-in, model-owned conversion from raw Chinese evidence to typed object/attribute/relation/goal candidates
required_next_slice.provenance: each candidate must retain input ID and byte/percept evidence span, confidence and ambiguity
required_next_slice.consumer: the same produced state must enter T1 correction, T2 retrieval and T3 prediction/selection without oracle targets at inference
tests: correction changes only the related current fact
related fact flip changes the answer or action
unrelated fact preserves the answer or action
ambiguous input abstains instead of silently receiving a structured fixture
checkpoint save/restore preserves producer parameters and source identity

limits.provider_evidence: retained as a separate interface/fallback; it cannot stand in for native producer capability evidence

next_development_step: N177.4: implement the opt-in native input-to-state producer and verify its source, correction, ambiguity and consumer path before freezing a semantic training course.
